name: Scandalous Rhapsody
original_name: スキャンダラス ラプソディ
source:
On a rainy day, Yui was dumped by his girlfriend. A very pretty girl comes along and offers him a handkerchief and even some "comfort". He was very smitten by how pretty she was and went into a lovehotel with her. Only to find out that "she" is actually a "he". Yui also finds out that his name is Runa and he was conceived in secret by a famous actress. Runa knows that his father is a famous actor and he wants Yui's help to meet with him. But if the media finds out about Runa's existence, there will be a huge scandal.

[From Aarinfantasy Forums]
translation:
一个雨天，Yui被女友甩了。一名非常漂亮的女孩走来，递给他手帕，甚至还给予了一些“安慰”。Yui被对方的美貌深深吸引，与她一同进入爱情旅馆，却发现“她”其实是“他”。Yui还得知，他名叫Runa，是一位著名女演员秘密生下的孩子。Runa知道父亲是一名著名男演员，希望Yui帮自己与他见面。但如果媒体发现Runa的存在，必将引发巨大丑闻。

[摘自Aarinfantasy Forums]
